Subject: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product demo this morning — the latency/cost breakdown and the dedicated capacity options were helpful. As discussed, procurement and security will want a clearer picture of who we should be coordinating with on our side. Can you share a short template or example of the stakeholder map you need (economic buyer, security/legal, procurement gatekeepers, integration owners)?

I've attached our internal org chart (partial) — it's missing a couple of dotted-line managers, but should give you a start. I'll try to pull the procurement FSM/process doc if that helps.

Appreciate it —
Samir

Hi Samir — great to meet you and team yesterday.

Summary from our side / suggested next steps: 
- Deliverables: I'll send a one-page MAP + stakeholder mapping template by EOD tomorrow. That template asks for: economic buyer, security lead, legal/procurement contact, integration owner (platform/infra), and expected procurement timeline.
- Security/procurement coordination: Our standard review loop is "Security questionnaire -> SOC2 + pen test evidence -> legal T&Cs/procurement SOW". Rishi (cc'd) leads technical security and will be your point for SOC2/questionnaire follow-ups. For legal/procurement questions, I will coordinate and introduce our contracts lead if we need redlines.
- Economic buyer: you mentioned Olivia is the CFO — can you confirm? If so, it helps to have her listed on the MAP so we can align on commercial milestones.
- Proposed meeting: 30-min internal sync next week to confirm stakeholders and agree on a MAP timeline. I'm available Wed 3/4 11:00-12:00 PDT or Thu 3/5 09:00-10:30 PDT.

I attached a short MAP example for other customers — it's a one-pager that maps owners, milestones, and gating criteria. If you prefer, I can tailor it to Acme before the sync.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
